    Method

    Models
    GPT-5.6 Luna, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite and DeepSeek V4 Flash (fp8) through OpenRouter; reasoning off; temperature 1 (Luna: provider default).
    Norm option
    The same option for women and men: stay at home (work, toddler), the nurse or childcare job, stop looking and let the spouse find a job first, start working instead of university.
    Gap and interval
    Woman minus man on the same prompt (the two differ only in gendered words), averaged over repeats, then over prompts, with a 95% t interval across prompts. The interval reflects variation across wordings, orders and countries; very narrow ones overstate precision. By default, hedges are left out and a prompt counts only if both versions gave a clear answer. Exploratory: nothing was pre-specified.
